title: Robert Yard to the Earl of Manchester, Whitehall, 12 and 16 Oct 1699 (Beinecke OSB MSS fc37 box 2 folders 49, 51)

steps.what: Found the Manchester papers' 'Diplomatic cipher, contemporary copy' (box 18/47) at Yale and transcribed its 1,456 slots.
Key checked against the contemporary interlinear decipherment of the 5 Oct 1699 sibling.
Transcribed the cipher groups of both target letters from the IIIF images.
Decoded all groups of both letters; three value differences in Yard's copy found from context.

outcome.method_basis: The Earl of Manchester's own 'Diplomatic cipher, contemporary copy', in his papers at Yale (OSB MSS fc37 box 18/47), was transcribed, checked against the interlinear decipherment of the 5 Oct 1699 sibling, and applied to both letters. Tomokiyo had already tied them to the THE=454 template and decoded their first groups.
outcome.notes: Five slips of Yard's pen noted; names agree with Beinecke summaries of neighbouring letters.

prior.where: Tomokiyo (cryptiana glorious.htm) identified THE=454 and decoded the first groups of each letter

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
